title: Runner label strings in lint.yml matrix must match step conditions, job name and cache keys
answers: Why are lint steps silently skipped after changing the runner OS?
How do I change the ubuntu runner in the lint matrix without breaking conditions?
Where is the runner label used in workflow if-conditions and cache keys?
body:
Invariant: the matrix `os` value in .github/workflows/lint.yml is repeated as literal strings in the job `name:` expression, in `if: matrix.os == '...'` guards (Add problem matchers, Check function signatures, Check whitespace-only changes, Check uv.lock changes), and in cache keys built from `${{ matrix.os }}`.
When the runner changes, update the matrix value and every literal comparison in the same file together.
What breaks if skipped: a guard that still compares against the old label evaluates false, so the check is skipped without an error. The lint job name also falls back to `lint-macos`.
Cache key prefixes in .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml embed the runner label too (`mypy-ubuntu-24.04-`, `install-bin-ubuntu-24.04-`, `pre-commit-ubuntu-24.04-`), so keys and restore-keys move together.
applies: Any workflow that compares matrix or runner labels in if-conditions, job names or cache keys; check these literals whenever a runner label changes.
says: Automated code quality checks are silently skipped after upgrading the continuous integration operating system
The continuous integration linting job displays the incorrect operating system name on pull requests
Build cache restoration fails after updating the pipeline operating system version
Update continuous integration runner operating systems without breaking step conditional checks and caches
search: The runner operating system label in .github/workflows/lint.yml must be kept synchronized across matrix os definitions, job name expressions, if-condition guards, and cache keys. Literal runner string mismatches cause guards like Check function signatures, Check whitespace-only changes, and Check uv.lock changes to evaluate false, silently skipping checks without errors while defaulting job names to lint-macos. Cache key prefixes in .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml, such as mypy-ubuntu-24.04-, install-bin-ubuntu-24.04-, and pre-commit-ubuntu-24.04-, also embed runner labels and must be updated alongside restore keys.
